survey.sub_type_reason: Sheet is dominated by terminal strips (T/S B, C, E, F), numbered terminal blocks (76-105), relays (Re12-Re14), a PC CARD controller with RUN IND./ALARM signal lines, and status taps routed to monitoring circuits, all joined by wiring to pump/sensor endpoints — matching relay/terminal wiring layout rather than a simple distribution schedule or one-line topology.

survey.notes: Two selector switches (S17, S18) control AUTO/ON/OFF modes for AFT and FWD grey water pumps respectively, each with RUN IND. and ALARM outputs routed through a PC CARD interface region (dotted boundary) — this dotted region is an enclosure boundary, not a signal path itself. Numerous numbered terminal points (76-105) span multiple physical terminal strips (T/S B, C, E) feeding a common alarm/status collection area labeled with load names (MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP, BACKUP EM POWER/GMDSS BACKUP) - these are status_signal taps to a monitoring bus, not power feeds. Reed sump switches and BY-PASS manual contacts sit near FWD/AFT crew head sump pumps. Some wire-gauge diamond callouts likely present on power lines (illegible at this resolution to confirm exact values). Fuses (1A) inline before several sump pumps. Text at far right of terminal group (7-12, T/S F) references DWG-120 and lists EMERGENCY LTS SW plus two 'not used' spares.

composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-115 "AFT SERVICE PUMPS") serves two distinct commodity systems both fed from the DC MAIN PANEL / MAIN PANEL: the AFT GREY WATER PUMP (Q1, S17 AUTO/ON/OFF, level sender) which maps to node 530-grey-water-pumps; and a group of dedicated sump pumps (PORT/STBD AFT GUEST GREY SUMP Q2/Q3, FWD/AFT CREW HEAD SUMP Q4/Q5, AFT A/C SUMP Q6) which all map to node 530-sump-pumps per the engineer-confirmed mapping table. A partial FWD GREY WATER PUMP control block (S18 selector + FWD sender) also appears at the bottom of the sheet and belongs to 530-grey-water-pumps (its physical pump is drawn/detailed elsewhere — likely a FWD service pumps sheet). Status taps for MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP feed into the alarm/monitoring collection here but those pumps' control loops live on other sheets; they are cross-references only. The numbered terminal group (76-105), PC CARD dotted enclosure, T/S B/C/E strips, and XA61/XA70/XA30 plug interfaces are shared infrastructure belonging to the panel/monitoring backbone (641-vessel-control-panel / 652-onyx-monitoring), not to individual pump nodes.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Load name 'AFT GREY WATER P.' on breaker Q1, with dedicated S17 ON/OFF/AUTO selector, RUN IND./ALARM outputs, level sender, and pump symbol labelled 'AFT GREY WATER PUMP' — matches engineer mapping AFT GREY WATER PUMP -> 530-grey-water-pumps.

functions.label: Aft grey water tank pump-out
functions.what_it_does: Pumps grey water from the aft grey water tank overboard; can be run automatically on level, forced ON, or locked OFF from the main panel.

flow_scenarios.path: S17 selector set to AUTO -> level-sensing logic on PC CARD (via T/S C terminals 76-79) -> Re12 relay coil energised -> pump runs when tank level calls for it -> discharge to AFT GREY WATER outlet
S17 selector forced ON -> pump runs continuously bypassing level control -> discharge to AFT GREY WATER outlet
S17 selector OFF -> pump de-energised, no discharge

RUN status and ALARM condition of this loop are tapped out via T/S C terminals 77 (RUN, fused) / 80-81 (ALARM) to XA61 pins 08/10/12 for onward monitoring (cross-reference, resolved on monitoring sheet)

facts: PC CARD dotted enclosure and terminal numbering 76-105 form the local controller/terminal interface for this sheet's loads, feeding RUN IND./ALARM lamps and onward XA61/XA70/XA30 plug taps.

T/S B (terminals 19/20 not used - spares), T/S C (76-81), T/S E (terminal 8 EMERGENCY BAT +24V; terminals 19/20 tied to terminal 96 loop) are terminal strips belonging to the panel infrastructure, not to individual pump nodes.

Status taps for MAST BILGE (pin5/term92), ENGINE ROOM BILGE (pin6/term93), OWNERS GREY SUMP (pin8/term94), FWD GUEST GREY SUMP (pin9/term95), AFT A/C SUP(PLY)/BACKUP EM POWER/GMDSS BACKUP (term96) are monitoring collection points for equipment detailed on OTHER sheets; only pass through this sheet's terminal group.
T/S F terminal block (right side) links via MU4-12 multi-core cable to another terminal strip referencing 'see DWG-120', feeding EMERGENCY LTS SW plus two spare (not used) ways.
